Name: The bigger the fish you catch the bigger it is in your hand.
Author: xjx2005
Description:
[line]
[b]Fish Size Visual[/b]
Got a huge legendary fish? Now you can SEE how big it is when holding it!
Only a visual add-on, no game balance changed at all.

✅ Function: Fish longer = bigger in your hands
✅ Required: Fish Price By Size (Nexus ID: 50970) + SMAPI
✅ Game Version: 1.6+

Just drop it into Mods after installing the main mod, done!
[line]

[b]鱼身大小视觉【中文】[/b]
钓上来巨型大鱼？这回拿在手里，一眼就能看出它有多霸气！
纯视觉小插件，丝毫不改动游戏平衡。

✅ 功能：鱼越长，握在手里体型越大
✅ 必备前置：按尺寸分类的鱼的价格（N网：50970）+ SMAPI
✅ 适配版本：星露谷物语 1.6及以上
装好主模组丢进Mods文件夹，直接开玩。
